notes.title: Update notes for Decemeber 26th
notes.notes:
* Fixes to some assets not being built correctly when reverting some of the animations
* Clothing issues should be solved
* Flipping should not get stuck upside down
* Start replay in non smooth camera (Can bind a controller button to activate it while in timeline mode)

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
* Rebalanced takeoff momentums
* Fixed flip bug
* Rebalanced control difficulties (change in options menu)
 -  (Optionally) Easier landings, no roll
 -  (Optionally) Less landing assist, no rail magnetism
* Reverted sensitivity more towards the older (this can be modified manually in qoptions file)

* Many bug fixess

notes.title: Christmas update
notes.notes:
This update is currently only active in the experimental branch. Look at the forums on how to active this.

This update includes
* Support for user created levels (check forums for more info)
* Steam Achievements
* Chat input bug fixed
* Whiskers missions rebalanced
* User created challenges will be cleared after 30 days
* Visual bug fixes on Home
* Visual bug fixes on Viking Pass East

notes.title: New Patch
notes.notes:
* New sky with dynamic clouds
* New tree's and tree system. 
* Takeoff and spin off rails. 
* Trail on packed snow.
* New quailty settings. (And potato shaders)
* Optimizations
* Always connects to an online session on start (Optional). 
* GUI improvements.
* Main menu is visible in missions with trick tips and grab controls. 
* Ragdoll improvements. 
* Polish and bug fixes
* The Double Rodeo 7 mission can now be completed with any Double flip.
